settings.title: AI SETTINGS
settings.body: Enable AI powered WHOOP Coach to get personalized advice and coaching to help you unlock optimal performance. You can disable this feature at any time.

settings.title: INCORPORATE WHOOP METRICS
settings.body: Allow WHOOP Coach to use your WHOOP metrics for a more personalized coaching experience. WHOOP Coach will analyze your unique data to generate recommendations that are specific to you. If enabled, your WHOOP metrics may be shared with our third-party Large Language Learning Model (LLM) partner. Even when enabled, the WHOOP metrics we share will not be stored, retained, or used for further training of LLM models.

settings.title: RESPONSE LENGTH
settings.body: Response length determines how detailed your WHOOP Coach responses will be. Select your preferred response length below:

settings.title: MEMORY
settings.body:
Allow WHOOP to remember details from past conversations to provide personalized guidance. 
All data is stored securely by WHOOP and never shared with a third party.

footer.title: Data privacy
footer.body: We exist to improve your life, not invade it. You control your personal data. Read more about our commitment to Data Privacy.
